title: Roadmap
seo: AI roadmap for the next six months
meta: A step by step AI plan for the next three to six months with owners, costs and order of work. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: An AI roadmap for the next three to six months
overview: A good plan keeps you from trying everything at once. We take what we learn about your goals, team and budget and lay out a month by month path, showing what to do first, what each step needs, who owns it and roughly what it costs. The roadmap is a clear document with checkpoints, so you can see when to continue, adjust or stop.

pkgs.blurb: A simple three month plan with the first steps listed.
A six month plan with costs, risks and checkpoints.
A detailed roadmap with budget, hiring needs and success measures.

faq: Do I need an audit before a roadmap?
It helps but is not required. If you have no audit, we run a short discovery chat first and base the roadmap on that. Larger roadmaps benefit from a full audit.
Will the roadmap include specific vendors?
It names tool types and a few example options where useful. We are independent and take no commission, so the choice stays yours.
How accurate are the cost ranges?
They are estimates from public pricing and typical effort, shown as ranges. Final costs depend on your volume and the tools you pick, so we mark each as low, likely or high.
Can you help carry out the plan?
Yes. Each initiative can be quoted as its own fixed price job. You can also give the roadmap to your own team or another provider to carry out.
